name: Bee Partners
identity_check: Confirmed as Bee Partners (beepartners.vc), the San Francisco pre-seed firm founded in 2009 by managing partner Michael Berolzheimer that backs founders 'at the forefront of human-machine convergence' (AI, robotics, automation, synthetic biology). Directory pages (UC Berkeley BEGIN, Endeavor Colorado, VC Sheet) link to beepartners.vc; TechCrunch and Crunchbase News cover its Fund III and Fund IV; SEC EDGAR lists Bee Partners I-IV, L.P. (Delaware, business address San Francisco). Not Bee (the Amazon-acquired wearable AI startup that TechCrunch search mixes in), not Beehouse Partners, Surge Busy Bee Partners or Copper Beech Partners (other EDGAR filers), and not KreditBee or Polybee. The firm's own site refused connections throughout, so its pages could not be read.

thesis_text.value: Pre-seed specialist ('inception investing') backing founders at the frontier of human-machine convergence: applied AI and machine-centric companies in robotics, automation, industry 4.0, voice and synthetic biology, grouped as human-machine interaction, machine-to-machine learning and biological machines. Runs a 'machines will win' thesis and leads or joins the first institutional round.

open_items: beepartners.vc refused every connection on 2026-10-30 (ECONNREFUSED on /, /latest, /team) and web.archive.org is blocked for fetching, so the firm's own team, portfolio, news and pitch pages were not read. Thesis and sectors come from directory copies of the firm's description (BEGIN, VC Sheet, Endeavor Colorado) plus press.

application_url: VC Sheet gives https://getfunded.beepartners.vc/ as the best way to get in touch, but that hostname did not resolve (ENOTFOUND) on 2026-10-30, so no URL is recorded and accepts_cold_inbound stays unknown.
requires_us_entity and invests_in_indian_founders: no statement found; VC Sheet lists geography as USA and every round found is a US company.
portfolio_count_reported: not found. CB Insights counts 134 investments (database); TechCrunch (2023) says Bee typically backs about 25 companies per fund and Fund IV had nine at the close.

SEC Form D amounts not read: www.sec.gov returned HTTP 403 to the 'CapitalAtlas research' User-Agent (data.sec.gov submissions and efts full-text search worked). Fund I and II initial Form D filings: 2011-10-19 and 2014-11-24.
Bee Partners Opportunities I: named by CB Insights only; size, vintage and Form D not found. No Fund V found.

Rounds: only three announced rounds in the last 24 months were found (C-Infinity Apr 2026, Octave May 2025, TensorStax May 2025). CB Insights also lists an AnyBio seed (2026-07-16) and two hidden 2025 deals, but no article for AnyBio was found. The other ten rounds are 2020-2024; robotics/automation among them are Reshape Automation (pre-seed, seed) and Rapid Robotics (seed, A, B).
Rapid Robotics later shut down, per TechCrunch (2025-09-12) quoting Kira Noodleman; its website is left null.
Octave round date (2025-05-30) comes from CB Insights; the company's announcement post is undated.

Sourcetable: TechCrunch's sentence can be read as Berolzheimer leading the $3M seed or the earlier $1.25M pre-seed; recorded as the seed lead. NextView and Long Journey are named only as being on the cap table.

Partners: VC Sheet also lists Garret Goldberg and Tim Smith as partners (Crunchbase News, 2019: Tim Smith promoted from advisor); not recorded because no industrial / AI / hardware focus was found. A beepartners.vc post titled 'Bee Partners Welcomes Jed Dean as Venture Partner' appeared in search results but could not be opened. No partner LinkedIn URLs could be taken from the firm's site.
Company LinkedIn URL comes from VC Sheet only (database). Endeavor Colorado lists offices in Denver and San Francisco; the HQ recorded is San Francisco (press, EDGAR).
TensorStax was reported by aggregators as acquired by Snowflake (Feb 2026); not verified.
